agent_tone_reviewer.notes: Agent maintained professional composure throughout hostile interaction and successfully arranged nurse callback per hospital policy.

patient_tone_reviewer.notes: Patient demanded immediate lab results access but refused portal guidance; eventually accepted nurse callback after escalating frustration and hostile language.

call_outcome_reviewer.notes: Patient's lab results request addressed but not fully resolved; nurse callback scheduled per policy but patient left dissatisfied.

coordinator_summary: This call demonstrates effective professional handling of a highly frustrated patient. Agent Aisha maintained composure, empathy, and clarity despite sustained hostility and personal insults from Mr. Cruz. The agent properly enforced clinical policy (nurse review of lab results rather than phone reading) and successfully arranged appropriate follow-up care through a nurse callback, demonstrating strong de-escalation and conflict management. Patient's emotional regulation was low throughout, with low respect and cooperation, though the patient ultimately accepted the proposed resolution. PHI compliance was excellent and no safety risks were identified. The partial resolution stems from policy constraints rather than agent failure; the nurse callback represents the appropriate clinical pathway.
